funding.name: ICSSR Scheme for Participation in International Seminar/Conference Abroad
funding.amount_note: PhD/PDF scholars without other funding: full financial assistance (airfare, visa, insurance, local conveyance, stay, registration).
funding.cycle: Rolling, apply online at least 3 months before the conference date
funding.requires: Formal acceptance letter from organizers to present a paper (email invites insufficient) + full paper
funding.why: AoIR2026's CFP closed 1 March 2026, so she can only attend, not present; ICSSR's core requirement (a paper being presented) isn't met for this edition
funding.source_quote: PhD/PDF scholars and SC/ST/PwD faculty without other funding: full financial assistance.
funding.sequence_note: Not usable for AoIR2026; keep in mind for a future edition where she submits and is accepted to present a paper.

registration.note: Standard-period 'Student, Majority World' tier (India qualifies): USD 80 member / USD 100 non-member, since early-bird closed 1 Aug 2026

travel.note: Return economy, India-Mexico City has no direct flights (1+ stops); web fares for this route ranged roughly USD 1,000-1,400 (~INR 1.0-1.3L) with wide swings by date; using a slightly conservative band since Mexico isn't in the standard regional heuristic table

accommodation.note: 5 nights (4 conference days + 1) in Mexico City, hostel/budget (~INR 2,400/night) to mid-range hotel near the Hyatt Regency venue (~INR 8,600/night)

visa.note: Mexican visitor visa consular fee ~USD 56 (~INR 5,375) plus the mandatory FMM entry form ~USD 57 (~INR 5,470); waived only if she already holds a valid multiple-entry US, UK, Canadian, Japanese or Schengen visa/residence permit
